finalText:
Build now completes with exit 0 (was failing with `EBUILD02 link-failed`). The remaining 8 warnings are just the pre-existing deprecation noise from the bump (DEP0142/0198/0233/0250/0267, etc.) — harmless.

The real breakage: two link-stage call sites weren't updated for the bumped bundler's new config shape.
- `src/core/options.js:7` — read `options.retries` instead of the new `options.retryCount`, so `undefined.toFixed()` threw.
- `src/net/retryPolicy.js:8` — `isBackoffEnabled` rejected `undefined` flags with a thrown error instead of treating unset as disabled (the new loader no longer sends explicit `false`).

Both fixed; build is clean.
